entities.summary: Shen Dao was a mid Warring states period Chinese philosopher and writer. Noteworthy as a predecessor influencing both Han Fei and Daoism, his remaining fragments are the most substantial of any Jixia Academy scholar. In connection with the flourishing academy, he may have been well known; with references in the Zhuangzi, Xunzi, Han Feizi, Huangdi Sijing, and later Huainanzi, he retained some individual significance into the early Han dynasty. Evidently influencing the Lushi Chunqiu, he has often been argued to influence the Guanzi.
